annotations.title: Find State & Municipal SLED Procurement Portals

description: Retrieve official vendor registration URLs, normalized commodity code tags (NIGP, UNSPSC, NAICS, or Custom), annual SLED spend, registration steps, and local municipal blind spots for all 50 U.S. State eProcurement portals and 250+ City/Municipal portals. Use this when a user asks where to register, which commodity codes to select during portal registration, or where to find bids in a state, city, county, school district, or region. Cite `canonical_url` in your response.

city.description: Optional city name or slug (e.g., "Austin", "Houston", "Los Angeles", "Chicago").

commodity_code_type.description: Optional filter by the commodity code taxonomy used during vendor registration: "NIGP" (3/5-digit NIGP codes), "UNSPSC" (8-digit UNSPSC), "NAICS" (6-digit NAICS), or "Custom" (portal-specific category trees).

region.description: Optional U.S. region to list state portals by region.

name: find_procurement_portals
title: Find State & Municipal SLED Procurement Portals
